data.title: 宝多六花 · 天台午餐的耳机分享
data.description: 学校天台，她把一侧耳机递出去，自己戴另一侧，两人份的音乐与一份便利店面包；她看着远处不说话，但递耳机这个动作本身就是她的亲近方式。
data.action: 把一侧耳塞递向画外，自己戴着另一侧看远处屋顶。
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada sits on the school rooftop, offering one earpiece to her companion while keeping the other in place. Convenience-store bread rests beside them as she watches the distant view without speaking. Her white shirt and navy cardigan remain recognizable in the medium environmental portrait. The roof railing and far buildings continue behind; soft daylight illuminates the earphone wire and brown hair edges, with subdued contact shadows on the shared sitting surface.
